newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends slightly lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends slightly lower in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices ended slightly lower in quiet trading, tracking a sell-off in gasoline and crude oil futures and on signs that very few cargoes were fixed for the United States this week.
Eurograde barges ended at $200/$202 fob ARA, down $2, and regular unleaded finished at $195/$198, traders said.
Cargoes were notionally unchanged at $204/$208 cif.
Traders said activity was very thin, with little demand between the end of the heating oil season and the start of the spring driving in the U.S. and Europe.
